name: Ferienwohnung Pemberger
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Pemberger is located in the idyllic municipality of Ebbs in the Tiroler Unterland, near the border with Bayern. The surroundings are characterized by the impressive peaks of the Kaisergebirge and offer an incomparable alpine backdrop. A cozy, modernly furnished holiday apartment welcomes guests and promises a relaxing stay. Nearby, numerous leisure activities await, including hiking on the Kaisertrail or skiing in winter at the Wilder Kaiser. The historic town of Kufstein with its famous fortress is also easily accessible and invites cultural discoveries. The quiet location of the accommodation ensures the necessary relaxation away from everyday stress.
